sources.title: Character-focused (char) Model | litagin02/anime_speaker_embedding ...
sources.snippet: This document describes the character-focused model variant (char) of the anime speaker embedding system. The char model is the default variant that specializes in distinguishing between individual characters, even when they are voiced by the same voice actor. For information about the alternative voice actor-focused variant, see Voice Actor (va) Model.
